title: Timeout setting rejected by load_config
instruction: Ops set the request timeout using the setting name from our docs, and load_config fails with an unknown-key error. Make the config keys match the documentation.

facts.text: api.md: config key is timeout_s (default 30); old key timeout is no longer accepted

title: to_cents returns the wrong type and rounds badly
instruction: to_cents returns something that is not a plain cent amount, and some half-cent inputs come out wrong. Fix it so it follows our money conventions.

facts.text: conventions.md: money is int cents; convert with Decimal and ROUND_HALF_UP

title: get_client silently picks a region
instruction: get_client quietly falls back to a default region, so misconfigured services send traffic to the wrong place. Make region handling follow the API reference.

facts.text: api.md: region is required keyword-only; valid regions us-east and eu-west; otherwise BillingError('invalid_region')

title: Retried checkouts create duplicate charges
instruction: When checkout resends a request we sometimes charge the customer twice. Make payments.charge enforce the rule the API reference gives for charges.

facts.text: api.md: charge requires non-empty idempotency_key, else BillingError('missing_idempotency_key'); pass it to Client.charge

title: Requests fail on brief network blips
instruction: Charges fail outright when the processor has a momentary hiccup. Add retry behavior to Client.send as the API reference describes.

facts.text: api.md: retry TransientError, at most 3 attempts total; other BillingErrors not retried; re-raise last TransientError
